response.justification: Technically this candidate far exceeds the bar: 15+ years of fullstack work, deep TypeScript/Node.js and React experience, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, strong testing/craftsmanship culture, and current exposure to LLM/agent infrastructure that maps well to the nice-to-haves. He is also Berlin-based, which fits the high on-site requirement. The problem is fit rather than ability: this is an advertised entry-level individual contributor role, and hiring a Staff/Senior engineer into it creates clear risks around compensation expectations, role satisfaction and retention. Secondary gaps are that his database depth is mostly MongoDB rather than PostgreSQL and there is no Nest.js on the resume. Worth a screening call only if the team is open to reshaping the role toward a senior/lead scope; otherwise decline.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React fullstack experience across many products
Berlin-based with strong AWS, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD background
Testing/clean-architecture mindset (TDD, pairing, trunk-based) plus AI/LLM tooling work
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level role — salary and retention risk
Database experience skews MongoDB; little evidence of PostgreSQL or Nest.js
Only basic German for an on-site energy-consulting/construction domain
